Efficacy and safety of insulin sensitisers for treating type 2 diabetes: a network meta-analysis. Thiazolidinediones (TZDs), including pioglitazone and rosiglitazone, and non-TZD insulin sensitisers (chiglitazar sodium) demonstrate potential; however, their comparative efficacy and safety remain unclear. Lobeglitazone improves glycaemic control as add-on therapy to empagliflozin plus metformin in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: A double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of triple therapy with lobeglitazone 0.5 mg as an add-on treatment compared with placebo in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) inadequately controlled with metformin and empagliflozin.
